ownerReasons.reason: ADR 0028 test-harness image, never shipped. The kind harness copies Twinfra's read-only Cilium lock (module-2/artifacts.lock.json at Twinfra 5801b8e: Cilium 1.20.2, with the same chart SHA-256), so adopting 1.20.3 would move the harness off that lock. The kind rehearsal is paused (IOT-WO-08 Amendment 2), so Cilium runs nowhere. KEV still blocks. This reason covers v1.20.3 only; v1.20.4 needs adoption or its own dated reason before 2026-11-23 UTC.
